notes.what_this_file_is: what the OWNER said about THIS project. It sits below the drawing and above the Urban Projects standard, and it never supplies geometry
notes.what_this_file_is_not: not a measurement, not a dimension read off a drawing, and not a quantity

pantry.why: the owner confirms the P7757 pantry is open toward the dining, saloon and living area and must not be forced into a closed physical room

elevator.why: the elevator standards are recorded in the rule library. No elevator geometry is established for P7757, so nothing is measured

DESIGN_ARCHITECTURAL.role: the plan, the walls and the spaces. Never replaced

DESIGN_DWF.role: a second representation: level marks and the sheet set. Its W2D positions are delta-encoded and this project has no reader for them

DESIGN_SANITARY.role: the drainage and water set, its own source with its own coordinates. Page 1 is the Ground Floor Drainage Plan and aligns to the ground-floor architectural plan at 38.0 mm per point; pages 2 and 3 do not align to the ground floor and nothing is placed from them
DESIGN_SANITARY.never: it does not replace or overwrite the architectural source
